prompt: Users can now choose to get alerts by SMS instead of email; store the choice in a new `User.Channel` field, "email" or "sms". Texts go through `SmsGateway.Send` in gateways.go, and `BuildService` in app.go already receives the gateway. Wire it up.
Users can also choose `push`: notifications to the app go through `PushGateway.Send(deviceToken, text)` in gateways.go, and `BuildService` already receives that gateway too. Wire it up.
